topics.name: Synthetic data for imbalanced learning
topics.summary: Across tabular, clinical, and image benchmarks, synthetic examples are used to reduce skew and test robustness. Quantum sampling, watermarking, rare-disease record generation, and label-controlled augmentation are assessed through utility, fidelity, and annotation-efficiency measures.

topics.name: Multimodal speech and sign language translation
topics.summary: Audio-visual speech, sign-language retrieval and translation, target extraction, and compact recognition systems align acoustic, visual, and linguistic signals. Transport-based matching, sequence modeling, tokenizer changes, and efficient decoding improve robustness across noisy, multilingual, and low-resource settings.

topics.name: Vision-language adaptation and open-vocabulary perception
topics.summary: Prompting, selective tokenization, metadata conditioning, test-time updates, and hidden-state analysis adapt vision-language systems without expensive retraining. Evaluations cover rare categories, fine detail, segmentation, visual reasoning, and transfer across domains and model backbones.

topics.name: Evidence-grounded language agents
topics.summary: Agentic retrieval systems connect unstructured records, knowledge graphs, medical timelines, and tables to verifiable decisions. Multi-stage search, scoped context updates, entity checks, test-time training, and citation controls aim to reduce unsupported claims and improve long-horizon reliability.

topics.name: Human-AI agency, bias, and social interaction
topics.summary: Controlled studies and educational deployments examine how sensing, generated choices, recommendation interfaces, tutoring, and personalized agents alter agency and social behavior. Findings repeatedly link opacity, central-option preferences, perceived support, consent, and visible oversight to user trust and participation.

topics.name: Sequential decision and bandit optimization
topics.summary: Correlated-arm bandits and multi-task Bayesian optimization use surrogate outcomes and task relationships to guide sequential choices. Their analyses emphasize transfer failures, uncertainty-aware routing, finite-sample alignment, and conservative exploration when related tasks are only partially informative.

topics.name: Efficient foundation-model inference
topics.summary: Hardware-aware compression, sparse attention, dynamic token selection, cache reuse, and constrained GPU decoding target serving bottlenecks in language and multimodal models. Measurements show that memory movement, output length, prefilling, and device-specific behavior can dominate savings from token pruning alone.

topics.name: Diffusion and generative media models
topics.summary: Diffusion and flow-based generators cover images, waveforms, dance, panoramas, sound effects, and text while addressing control, sampling cost, temporal coherence, and training noise allocation. Distillation, hierarchical conditioning, latent anchoring, and entropy-guided exploration improve quality under tight generation budgets.

topics.name: Language-model safety and behavioral evaluation
topics.summary: Alignment studies probe emergent misbehavior, self-training effects, geopolitical framing, representational drift, quantized reasoning, and confidence calibration. The recurring lesson is that aggregate scores can hide fragile failure modes, so audits need matched controls, multidimensional metrics, and independent trust judgments.

topics.name: Multi-agent orchestration and persistent memory
topics.summary: Multi-agent planners coordinate exploration, worldbuilding, embodied tasks, and tool calls through auctions, compressed shared state, selective memory, and decentralized policies. These mechanisms reduce redundant dialogue and preserve useful context while handling heterogeneous capabilities, limited communication, and changing task demands.

topics.name: Software agents and formal program verification
topics.summary: Coding and theorem agents combine retrieval, planning, contracts, interactive proof, trajectory analysis, and explicit testing to make repository changes and generated programs more dependable. Studies show that verifiability, failure localization, and maintenance cost matter alongside task completion.

topics.name: Cybersecurity and legal decision support
topics.summary: Legal retrieval, debate, document malware analysis, agent risk governance, fraud-control workflows, threat classification, and security recommendation systems turn language and graph structure into auditable actions. Evaluations stress traceability, policy constraints, risk tiers, and the gap between benchmark detection and deployment decisions.

topics.name: Event-based vision and visual tracking
topics.summary: Asynchronous event streams are paired with RGB features, symmetry-aware filters, and adversarial testing for tracking, anomaly detection, recognition, and fast edge perception. Benchmarks expose sensitivity to motion, illumination, temporal heads, and attacks that preserve plausible sensor observations.

topics.name: Autonomous aerial and driving perception
topics.summary: Aerial and road-vehicle systems combine radar, stereo, range correction, occupancy reasoning, long-tail synthesis, and safety filtering. Datasets and closed-loop evaluations target occlusion, sparse targets, degraded navigation, changing viewpoints, and failures that appear only after deployment.

topics.name: Semi-supervised and long-tailed visual recognition
topics.summary: Coresets, semantic neighbor graphs, synthetic label studies, balanced retraining, and multi-branch classifiers improve recognition when labels are scarce or class frequencies are skewed. Results favor selective examples, better calibration, and domain-specific evaluation over uniform expansion of the training set.

topics.name: Medical imaging and pathology
topics.summary: Medical vision systems address subgroup auditing, radiographic localization, pathology foundation models, lesion segmentation, MRI analysis, clustering, and cytology calibration. Generalist-specialist transfer, lightweight adaptation, active slide selection, and probability calibration improve portability while exposing metadata and cohort limitations.

topics.name: Clinical multimodal prediction and survival analysis
topics.summary: Clinical prediction studies model missing modalities, censored outcomes, acquisition cost, and real consultation dialogue. Routing policies, Shapley-based modality analysis, competing-risk tools, and adaptive evidence collection connect model accuracy with practical prognosis and patient-facing safety.

topics.name: Physics-informed scientific machine learning
topics.summary: Physics-aware neural models support motor control, optimal transport, elastic fields, aerial and underwater design, bioprocesses, chemical kinetics, digital twins, fringe projection, and conservation laws. Priors, invertibility, calibration, and shock-aware message passing improve data efficiency and extrapolation beyond purely empirical fits.

topics.name: Optimization theory and statistical learning
topics.summary: Theoretical studies analyze nonconvex schedules, high-dimensional influence, contrastive generalization, causal boosting, representation collapse, and reparameterized optimization. Across asymptotic and empirical settings, guarantees depend on conditioning, information floors, tail behavior, and the geometry of the learned parameterization.

topics.name: Graph learning, causal inference, and inverse problems
topics.summary: Graph matching, node centrality, private community recovery, causal discovery, authorship testing, attribution, weak-lensing inference, and variable-projection recovery use structural constraints to stabilize difficult estimation. The papers connect identifiability and uncertainty to noise, hidden confounding, privacy, and computational scaling.

topics.name: Quantum machine learning and control
topics.summary: Quantum studies span logic, repeater routing, device tuning, information-theory infrastructure, discrete sampling, reservoir computing, and regime-sensitive financial classification. Fair classical baselines, factorized actions, topology-aware feedback, and reproducible workflows temper broad advantage claims while identifying useful control niches.

topics.name: Molecular modeling and generative chemistry
topics.summary: Molecular methods infer structure from NMR or measurements and generate proteins, macrocycles, and three-dimensional compounds. Graph representations, flow-based generation, all-atom pretraining, and physical constraints improve candidate ranking, conformation prediction, and chemical coverage.

topics.name: Time-series forecasting and adaptive sensor learning
topics.summary: Forecasting and sensing systems use adaptive gates, distribution-valued regression, terminal reduction, online battery updates, and sample-size diagnostics. Applications range from electric vehicles and inertial devices to retail and heterogeneous temporal data, with emphasis on drift, feature selection, and deployment limits.

topics.name: Tactile and force-aware robot manipulation
topics.summary: Dexterous and teleoperated manipulation combines tactile arrays, miniature force-torque sensing, contact-centric control, elastic motion maps, and vibrotactile or physiological feedback. Real-robot benchmarks show gains in force regulation, failure diagnosis, and operation when vision or communication is incomplete.

topics.name: Video-based robot skill learning
topics.summary: Robot policies learn from videos, unlabeled subtask demonstrations, simulation, and action chunks while enforcing reachability, collision, geometry, and temporal structure. Object-centric features, spline actions, diffusion bridges, and feasibility filters help transfer observed behavior to different embodiments.

topics.name: Social navigation and multi-robot exploration
topics.summary: Navigation research combines predictive human-motion models, virtual-reality studies, diffusion planning, visibility-aware braking, and topology-aware exploration. Evaluations balance collision avoidance, comfort, progress, and discovery of reachable regions under partial observability and changing obstacles.

topics.name: Robotic state estimation
topics.summary: State-estimation work emphasizes reproducible implementations as well as filtering algorithms. LiDAR-inertial odometry ports, quadruped libraries, and vascular navigation models reveal how middleware, numerical stability, geometry, and sensor uncertainty affect comparisons between simulation and physical operation.

topics.name: 3D reconstruction and geometric scene understanding
topics.summary: Geometric vision systems recover people, objects, materials, camera motion, and interactive scenes from sparse, monocular, or panoramic observations. Foundation-model priors, splatting, inverse rendering, scale reasoning, and scene graphs improve consistency across views and support downstream localization or exploration.

topics.name: Cross-view visual re-identification and retrieval
topics.summary: Cross-domain retrieval methods align camera-trap videos, product photographs, aerial-ground identities, indoor revisits, and category-agnostic poses. Multi-prototype memories, contrastive staging, text descriptions, and contextual cues help preserve identity despite viewpoint, environment, and catalog-to-real appearance shifts.

topics.name: Spectral imaging and remote sensing
topics.summary: Multispectral, thermal, and mobile sensing systems classify terrain, inspect photovoltaic panels, segment remote scenes, and monitor hydrogen leaks. Band relationships, self-supervised features, trajectory analysis, and compact detectors improve robustness to illumination, material variation, and safety-critical deployment conditions.

topics.name: Historical text and scholarly language processing
topics.summary: Historical-document and scholarly-text systems address character normalization, abbreviation reversal, manuscript style, thematic indexing, cross-lingual idioms, and research-community interaction. Sequence models, graph representations, and human-oriented evaluation make archival material more searchable while retaining uncertainty about interpretation.

topics.name: EEG, affect, and behavioral sensing
topics.summary: Multimodal behavioral studies combine EEG, gaze, facial motion, physiological response, virtual environments, and generated visual stimuli. Contrastive, topological, and cross-refinement models support emotion, dream-state, ambivalence, social-intelligence, and micro-action analysis with more granular evaluation than coarse labels allow.

topics.name: Explanation, saliency, and concept auditing
topics.summary: Explanation methods test whether selected pixels, concepts, or rationales actually preserve model behavior and remain stable under perturbation. Saliency masks, Rashomon-style explanation sets, concept audits, conformal regions, and semantic abstraction analyses expose gaps between plausible narratives and faithful evidence.

topics.name: Robust and offline reinforcement learning
topics.summary: Offline-to-online learning, inverse reinforcement learning, risk-aware decision processes, reward-hacking analysis, and adversarial team games model uncertainty instead of collapsing it into one objective. Reliable value estimates, nonparametric preferences, and regret-sensitive policies improve transfer when rewards or opponents are not fully known.

topics.name: Portfolio and decision optimization
topics.summary: Portfolio, assortment, pairwise-comparison, trade, and medicine-allocation studies incorporate cardinality, ambiguity, reference values, and scarce-data constraints. Evolutionary search, distributionally robust optimization, neural predicates, and decision-aware training connect mathematical objectives to operational allocation choices.

topics.name: Financial fraud detection and forecasting
topics.summary: Financial applications combine transactional, behavioral, event-sequence, and language evidence for fraud detection, merger forecasting, liquidity analysis, retail prediction, and fair pricing. Benchmarks and multi-objective policies emphasize rare-event recall, customer friction, calibration, and robustness to changing regimes.

topics.name: Recommender systems and retrieval
topics.summary: Recommendation pipelines use semantic planning, candidate generation, soft feature tokens, agent selection, and batched annotation to handle sparse catalogs and heterogeneous signals. Evaluations focus on long-tail coverage, ranking quality, route choice, latency, and the cost of language-model-based enrichment.

topics.name: Foundation-model training and efficient language models
topics.summary: Language-model training studies span mixture-of-experts design, multilingual open releases, component-wise initialization, pruning, continual retention, and unlearning. The shared concern is how data composition, parameter geometry, active capacity, and selective updates change quality, memory use, and collateral behavior.

topics.name: Adversarial testing and biometric anti-spoofing
topics.summary: Generative input search, acoustic actuation, ocular challenge-response, and audio deepfake evaluation probe speech, camera, and biometric systems through realistic perturbations. Results show that physical plausibility, demographic composition, and calibration all affect the apparent security of a detector.

topics.name: Tomographic image reconstruction
topics.summary: Learning-based tomography methods address sparse or unusual acquisition paths and accurate rotation-axis localization. Differentiable reconstruction analysis and AI-assisted center estimation improve stability under noise, shift variation, and reduced projection coverage.

topics.name: Data-centric corpus and dataset tooling
topics.summary: Corpus tools inspect web-scale text containment and scientific dataset readiness before model training. Their workflows emphasize provenance, licensing, metadata completeness, repeatable enrichment, and release-quality checks rather than treating data preparation as an opaque preprocessing step.

topics.name: Interpretable and symbolic neural computation
topics.summary: Explicit algebraic approximators, differentiable logic networks, symbolic neural execution, fact-storing MLPs, and path-integral cognition make internal computation more inspectable. These approaches trade some unconstrained flexibility for traceable operations, compact representations, or hypotheses about emergent reasoning.

topics.name: Multimodal and agentic AI evaluation
topics.summary: Benchmarks for map reasoning, audio-visual generation, multimodal question answering, and agentic educational workflows measure grounded behavior rather than answer fluency alone. Structured tasks, human judgments, and failure-oriented scoring expose visual, temporal, and interaction weaknesses that ordinary accuracy misses.

topics.name: Cross-modal alignment and accessible generation
topics.summary: Cross-modal systems align music with local audio structure and convert textual descriptions into tactile graphics with geometric and fabrication constraints. Both emphasize fine-grained correspondence so generated representations remain useful to people or downstream devices rather than merely semantically related.
